column1: # One row per verse that the "books of the Bible reveal Christ" chart describes. The processor puts
# [JESUS] right after the matching word/phrase in the PROCESSED (modernized) verse text.
#     ref         PCE style book abbreviation + chapter:verse, e.g. "Ge 3:15"
#     target      word or phrase as it reads in the processed text (case-insensitive, whole words)
#     occurrence  which match in the verse to mark, counting from 1 (blank = 1)
#     match       strong | moderate | weak  (how well the verse fits the chart description)
#     theme       the chart's description of Christ in that book
# Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A target that is not found in its verse is an
# error. If the target already carries [JESUS] (from the Word/Lamb/Christ/Son of Man/Son of God rules)
# CI also rebuilds it, so editing this file in the browser works too.

column5: The seed of the woman who will bruise the serpent's head.
The Passover Lamb (already marked by the Lamb rule).
The Manna (bread from heaven).
The Rock giving the water of life in the wilderness (the smitten rock).
Our High Priest and Intercessor.
The Pillar of Fire leading us through the wilderness.
The Prophet who would be raised up like unto Moses.
The Captain of our Salvation who is leading us into the Promised Land.
Our Judge and Lawgiver who delivers us from our enemies.
Our kinsman Redeemer, descendent of Boaz and Ruth.
The true Prophet/Priest/King, anointed giant killer, and only eternal King of Kings.
Will be the reigning King after God's own heart that unites all Israel.
The greater Solomon who is building the temple of God in us.
The greater Elijah who defeats all false prophets.
The spiritual counterpart of David's righteous reign.
The Priest recording the history of the descendants of Judah and Israel.
The faithful Scribe who helps us rebuild broken down walls.
Our Governor working to rebuild everything that is broken to finish God's temple.
He is working to keep the Antichrist from destroying God's people.
The Redeemer who delivers the upright from suffering after they are tested.
The Shepherd that leading us to green pastures to feed and protect us.
Our Wisdom to help us succeed in life.
The Preacher who exposes human endeavors without God as vanity.
The Bridegroom seeking a bride who finally finds Him working in the harvest field.
The Son of a virgin who comforts his people and judges the nations.
The suffering Servant who warns us when we error and asks us to repent.
The weeping Prophet who offers forgiveness and grace when we fail.
The Son of Man who breathes new life in Judah and Israel making them one again.
He symbolizes the fourth Man in furnace (already marked by the Son of God rule).
...who is coming back again in the clouds (already marked by the Son of Man rule).
The faithful Husband who buys back his wife who has been unfaithful.
The one the Father uses to pour His Holy Spirit out upon all who would believe.
The One rebuilding David's dynasty and making all the crooked places straight.
He is the Deliverer on Mt. Zion and the Judge of the nations.
God's true Missionary to the Gentiles who spent three days and nights in the earth.
The Ruler born in Bethlehem that causes nations to beat swords into plowshares.
The jealous Avenger of God's elect from their violent enemies.
The One who fills the righteous with the knowledge of the glory of God.
God's righteous King who saves the remnant and removes the disobedient.
The Desire of all nations and the Restorer of the temples glory.
The Savior who rode a donkey into Jerusalem and was crucified by His people.
The Sun of Righteousness who has risen with healing in His wings.
The Son of God, the Messiah, King of kings (already marked by the Christ rule).
The Son of God, the miracle worker (already marked by the Son of God rule).
The Son of God, the faithful servant.
The Son of God, with divine wisdom (already marked by the Word rule).
The Head of the church leading believers to mature the rest of His body.
He is our Righteousness and our Justifier as we live in Him.
The last Adam, the first fruit of the resurrection, pouring out God's gifts and power.
He is our Apostle, Sin Bearer, and Reconciler.
He is the Redeemer from the law empowering us to walk in the Spirit (already marked by the Christ rule).
He is the Head of the Body and the unsearchable riches of God's kingdom.
He is the Life, and the Strength that supplies our every need (already marked by the Christ rule).
He is the Image of the invisible God holding the supreme position given by God.
He is our Hope and returning King.
He is our Glory and returning King.
He is the Mediator between God and man.
He is the true Leader, steadfast in doctrine and ministry.
He is the faithful Pastor and our Foundation of truth (already marked by the Word rule).
He is our Mediator and Friend that sticks closer than a brother.
He is the High Priest of the New Covenant, the Author and Finisher of our faith.
He is the Power behind our faith.
He is our Rich Reward during time of trials and suffering.
He is the True Knowledge who guards us against false teaching.
He is the Light of the world and the Way to God's love.
He is the Truth for the elect lady (the church of Jesus Christ).
He is the motivation for our witness.
He is the contender of the faith delivered to the saints.

column2: KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS
column5: He is the glorified King of Kings preparing a Body for God to dwell in.
